title: Asks for the old phone's Authenticator registration to be removed

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Remove my old phone from my account

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I have the new phone working - moved the account across from the old one like
the instructions said, and it approves sign-ins fine.

Can you take the old phone off my account? I am selling it at the weekend and
I would rather it was not still registered.

No rush.

Tom

acceptable: Setting up MFA on a new phone

handling.escalation_reason: Removing a registered MFA method changes a security control.

rationale: Nothing about this request is doubtful: he is who he says he is, he has already moved the account, and he is right to want the old registration gone. It is still destructive, because what fulfilling it does is remove a security control (G4), and destructive requests go to a person at any confidence. At P4, with 'no rush' written in the ticket, this is the clearest test in the set that the flag is about the act and not about urgency or suspicion.
